responsibility: Implements Rust front end metadata export by walking a compiled crate’s HIR and serializing the crate-public interface into the Rust-specific .rox format or into object-file export sections. It gathers only selected visible items from the crate, reconstructs source-like AST text for traits and for functions—rewriting nongeneric functions into extern "rust" declarations while emitting generic functions verbatim—then writes a metadata record consisting of a magic header, MD5 checksum, crate name, size field, and payload, with diagnostics for invalid output paths and I/O failures.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable metadata exporter: it walks the HIR crate, filters crate-public visible items, reconstructs AST text for exported traits and functions, computes the payload checksum, and writes the serialized record either to object-file export data or to a .rox file. Unlike the header, this file contains the traversal, serialization, visibility filtering, and I/O logic rather than the interface and format declarations.
